verdict.title: Downtrend - the strategies wait for a clean 4H / 1H
verdict.meaning: BTC is falling on the daily chart (the price trend line below). The strategy filter is stricter: it trades a SHORT only when 4H and 1H both show a clean downtrend, because a grinding fall with bounces stops out early shorts. A SHORT alert comes once they agree.
fits: no longs, no buying the dip
checking the stop of any open long
waiting for a SHORT alert - it often comes after a bounce fails
avoid: buying the dip (catching a falling knife)
shorting by hand right after a big red candle, at the lows
